T: The Bride is back. She's hungry.
D: The Bride works through the rest of her list and finally faces Bill.
P: Serve the mains when the Bride finally reaches Bill's place in Mexico.
S: the bowl of rice Pai Mei knocks away
Short grain rice washed until the water runs clear, cooked with a splash of sake, served in small bowls with furikake, a pickled plum and a soft egg boiled 6 and a half minutes. Chopsticks only.
El Paso chapel beef cheek tacos
the wedding rehearsal at the little chapel in Texas

Beef cheeks braised with dried chillies, garlic and cumin until they shred, in warm corn tortillas with white onion, coriander, lime and a fierce salsa roja. Toast 4 dried guajillo chillies, soak in hot water for 20 minutes and blitz with 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and 400g crushed tomatoes. Brown 1kg beef cheeks, pour over the sauce with 500ml beef stock, cover and braise at 150C for 4 hours. Shred in the sauce. For salsa roja, blitz 2 charred tomatoes, 2 chipotles in adobo and lime. Serve in 16 warm corn tortillas with diced white onion, coriander and lime.
Budd's run-down trailer in the desert
Corn chips with a hot cheese sauce of cheddar melted into evaporated milk with pickled jalapeño juice, beef jerky on the side, all in plastic bowls.
M: Pork shoulder in big chunks simmered slowly in lard with orange, garlic, bay and salt for 3 hours, then crisped hard in a hot pan, in tortillas with salsa verde of charred tomatillo, chilli and coriander.
a kid's dinner at the villa

Tuna mixed with mayo, celery, spring onion and lemon, piled on buttered sourdough under bubbling cheddar, cut into fingers with a crunchy apple slaw. Drain 2 x 185g tins tuna and mix with 4 tbsp mayo, a finely diced celery stick, 2 sliced spring onions, lemon juice and pepper. Butter 4 thick slices sourdough and toast under the grill. Pile on the tuna and cover with 150g grated cheddar. Grill 3 minutes until bubbling and cut into fingers. Toss a julienned apple and quarter of a shredded cabbage with 2 tbsp mayo and lemon for slaw.
W: Crumbly, buttery Chinese almond cookies made with almond meal, each with a whole almond pressed into the top and an egg glaze, baked golden. Beat 150g butter with 120g sugar and 1 egg, add 1 tsp almond extract, then 220g flour, 50g almond meal and 1 tsp baking powder. Roll into 20 balls, press an almond into each, brush with egg and bake at 175C for 14 minutes.
K: Blanco tequila with fresh pink grapefruit and lime juice, a little agave, topped with soda over ice in a chilli salt rimmed glass. Mix 2 tbsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a plate. Rub the rims of four tall glasses with lime and dip in the salt, then fill with ice. Into each glass pour 45ml blanco tequila, 60ml fresh pink grapefruit juice, 15ml lime juice and 10ml agave syrup. Top with 60ml soda water, stir and add a grapefruit wedge.

s.how: Wash 300g short grain rice until the water runs clear. Cook with 360ml water and 2 tbsp sake. Boil 4 eggs for 6 and a half minutes, cool and peel. Serve rice in small bowls with furikake, a pickled plum and a halved egg.

s.note: Budd's run-down trailer in the desert
s.how: Warm 375ml evaporated milk until steaming, then stir in 250g grated cheddar until smooth. Add 2 tbsp pickled jalapeño juice and a few chopped jalapeños. Pour into plastic bowls with corn chips and 100g beef jerky on the side.

m.how: Cut 1.2kg pork shoulder into big chunks and simmer slowly in 500g lard with 1 halved orange, 4 garlic cloves, 2 bay leaves and salt for 3 hours. Crisp in a hot pan. Char 400g tomatillos with a chilli, blitz with coriander. Serve in 16 warm tortillas.
